raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Associate BNP Paribas
Feb 2025 - Present
Mumbai , Maharashtra
Middle Office Static Data
Managed setup and maintenance of static data (portfolios, brokers, custodians) in Tradeflow.
Supported global trade lifecycle processes and STP operations.
Resolved static data queries and ensured SLA adherence.
Initiated callback procedures when SSI was unavailable or change in SSI to ensure accurate settlement instructions.
Participated in audits, regulatory updates, and internal projects.
Supported custody migration activities and ensured smooth transition with minimal settlement impact.
Trade Processing Fixed Income
Processing Fixed Income trades to ensure accurate accounting in HiPort.
Resolving discrepancies related to security mismatches between accounting records and SWIFT details.
Monitoring trade settlement status in NeoLink and taking appropriate actions for settled and unsettled trades.
Cancelling and manually inputting trades into HiPort accounting system when required.
Transferring dummy ISINs to live ISINs for accurate trade processing and settlement.
Ensuring timely resolution of trade and static data issues while maintaining operational accuracy.
INTERNSHIP Axis Bank
Feb 2024 - Apr 2024
Branch Banking to assist customers to perform financial function.
Developed skills in client interaction & financial advisory services.
Did customer research on high churn rate among their credit card customers.
Gained exposure to various financial functions including cheque clearing & deceased claim processing
Mar 2022 - Aug 2022
Shriram General Insurance Company
Filed GST Returns for the company & determining the block credit and its reversal there of u/s17(5)
Auditing of balance sheets and helping in preparing the respective financial statements in accordance with financial reporting
